title: Configure the storefront, markups and fees in the OTA admin
summary: The owner opens the console, sets a 10 % markup and a booking service fee, changes the brand colour, publishes a content page, tries a broken e-mail template, limits offers per search and turns on the airline card and self-service cancellation; each change is checked where travellers see it.
prerequisites: An active OTA of your own and its storefront on the dev server (`STOREFRONT_DEV_HOST=<key>.ota.example.com`, [[journey:signup-and-provision]]).
Signed in to the portal as the OTA's owner.

steps.title: Open the console from the portal
steps.actions: On the OTA's page press **Open console**.
steps.expect: A brief hand-off page, then `http://localhost:3002/bookings` with the OTA's name in the shell and the TEST badge. Page titles end with `· Velexis OTA admin`.
steps.data: Redis: the `ptk:*` key is gone (single use); a `staffsess:*` key exists. OTA admin cookies `__Host-vx_staff_at`, `__Host-vx_staff_rt`, `__Host-vx_env`, `__Host-vx_tenant` are httpOnly.

steps.title: Note the net prices first
steps.actions: Search MAD → PAR for a date 45 days ahead and note the five prices.
steps.expect: Under the seeded default markup of 0 % the prices equal the stub's net prices.

steps.title: Set the default markup rule to 10 %
steps.actions: Open the rule **Default** (badge Default, priority 1000); keep *Percentage of the net price*; type **Percentage** `10`; press **Save changes**. Then search the storefront again for a **different** date (46 days ahead: identical searches are shared for 30 s).
steps.expect: A saved status message. Each of the five offers now costs its net price plus 10 %, rounded half-up to the cent.
steps.data: `SELECT name, calculation, percentage, is_default, version FROM tenant_<key>.markup_rules;` → `Default`, `percentage`, `10.0000`, version + 1. `SELECT action, outcome FROM tenant_<key>.staff_actions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;` → `settings.markupRules.update`, `succeeded`. No cache is involved: rules are read by the next search.

steps.title: Add a booking service fee of €7.50
steps.actions: Press **New fee rule**: **Name** `Service fee`, **Label** `Service fee`, **Fee type** *Booking service fee*, **Calculation** *Fixed amount*, **Fixed amount** `7.50`, **Currency of the amounts** `EUR`, **Computed** *Per booking*; press **Create fee rule**. On the storefront open the cheapest offer, keep its fare and look at the price page.
steps.expect: The rule's page opens. On `/price.html` the **Price details** list *Service fee €7.50* and the total is €7.50 above the offer's price.
steps.data: `SELECT name, label, fee_type, calculation, fixed_amount, currency, applies_per, refundable, is_active FROM tenant_<key>.fee_rules;`

steps.title: Change the primary colour
steps.actions: On **Brand and theme** set the primary colour to `#7c2d12` (the editor shows the contrast verdict) and press **Save branding and theme**. Reload the storefront in the tab you already had open, then open it in a **new** tab.
steps.expect: "Saved. The storefront shows the change within 5 minutes." The old tab keeps its 5-minute copy of the configuration (old colour) until that copy expires; the new tab shows the new colour on the search button (`--vx-primary`).

steps.title: Publish a content page
steps.actions: On **Pages** press **New page**: **Address** `about`, **Language**, **Title**, a **Body**, tick "Published on the storefront" and "Listed in the storefront footer"; press **Create page**. Open `http://localhost:5173/p/about` (or **View on storefront**).
steps.expect: The storefront shows the page's title and text, and its footer links it. An unpublished page or an unknown slug answers the storefront's not-found page.
steps.data: `SELECT slug, locale, kind, title, is_published, show_in_footer FROM tenant_<key>.storefront_pages;`

steps.title: Try an e-mail template that does not compile
steps.actions: Open `booking.confirmed` (e-mail, your locale). On line 2 of the **HTML body** open a mustache `{{` without closing it; press **Save**. Reload.
steps.expect: *The template does not compile*, one problem *HTML body, line 2: …* with the link *Go to line 2 of the HTML body*; nothing saved; after the reload the previous body is back.

steps.title: Limit the offers per search
steps.actions: On **Features and search**, in the **Search** section, set **Offers per search** to `40`, press **Save search**, run a storefront search, then open **Supplier log** (`/supplier-log`) and find that search's Flight Offers Search call. Press **Use the default** and **Save search** again.
steps.expect: "Saved. The storefront's next search asks Amadeus for this number of offers." The field shows "Default: 150 offers per search" beside it. The supplier log shows the Amadeus call with `max=40`; after **Use the default**, the next search asks for `max=150`. Saving the same value twice: "Nothing to save: the offers per search are as shown."

steps.title: Turn on the airline card and self-service cancellation
steps.actions: On **Payments** tick *Offer the airline card in the test environment* and press **Save airline card**. On **Features and search** tick *Self-service cancellation* and press **Save features**. Look at the live airline-card box.
steps.expect: Both sections answer "Saved…"; the airline card's save says "Saved with warnings:" with the API's `airline_card_net_price` warning, because the active 10 % markup and the fee do not apply to airline-card bookings. The live airline-card box stays unavailable with the explanation that the platform turns it on after its security review. These switches are needed by [[journey:book-with-airline-card]] and [[journey:my-bookings-change-and-cancel]].
